claims.action: Gunan, Yehe's son, was skilled in horsemanship and archery and gifted with ability.
claims.sourceText: 骨赧，冶訶子，善騎射，有材幹。

claims.action: He took part in suppressing the rebellions of Huanhan, Sanda, Wuchun, Womouhan, and Liuke and distinguished himself in each.
claims.sourceText: 從討桓赧散達、烏春、窩謀罕、留可之叛，皆有功。

claims.action: When Taizu campaigned against Liao, Gunan fought at Ningjiangzhou and Chuhedian, broke the Liao emperor's personal guard, and was rewarded each time for valor in battle. He inherited his father's commandery.
claims.sourceText: 從太祖伐遼，骨赧從軍戰甯江州出河店，破遼主親軍，皆以力戰受賞，襲其父謀克。

claims.action: He led a thousand households under Zonghan, Prince of Qin, and helped take the Central and Western capitals.
claims.sourceText: 領秦王宗翰千戶，攻下中、西兩京。

claims.action: When Zonghan marched on Song he besieged Taiyuan without success and returned to the Western Capital. Gunan held Taiyuan with the right wing under Yinshu Ke.
claims.sourceText: 宗翰伐宋，圍太原未下，宗翰還西京，骨赧以右翼軍佐銀術可守太原。

claims.action: Relief columns came from Fenzhou, Tuanbai, Yuci, Lan, Xian, and Lu. Gunan fought four engagements and won them all.
claims.sourceText: 是時汾州、團柏、榆次、嵐、憲、潞皆有兵來援，骨赧凡四戰，皆破之。

claims.action: While the main army besieged Bian, Gunan led the ten-thousand-household force and repeatedly routed Song relief columns.
claims.sourceText: 大軍團汴，骨赧引萬戶軍，屢敗其援兵。

claims.action: When Xian, Lu, and other prefectures rebelled again, he retook them, pacified Baode and Huoshan, and returned.
claims.sourceText: 憲、潞等州複叛，骨赧引兵複取之，並收撫保德、火山而還。

claims.action: He later commanded the Xia frontier garrison for twelve years.
claims.sourceText: 後領軍鎮夏邊，在職十二年。

claims.action: In Tianhui 8 he received a hereditary meng'an.
claims.sourceText: 天會八年，授世襲猛安。

claims.action: At the opening of Tianjuan he became military governor of Tiande Army and retired.
claims.sourceText: 天眷初，為天德軍節度使，致仕。

claims.action: He rose by stages to Grand Master of the Palace with Equal Protocol and died at eighty-five.
claims.sourceText: 累遷開府儀同三司，卒，年八十五。

claims.action: His son Xige inherited the meng'an and was made General of Manifest Martiality.
claims.sourceText: 子喜哥襲猛安，加宣武將軍。

claims.action: Yehe's sons were Alubu, Gunan, Egunai, and Sanda.
claims.sourceText: 冶訶子阿魯補、骨赧、訛古乃、散荅。

claims.action: He entered court as Junior Household Master of the Heir Apparent, became Military Governor of Kaiyuan Army, inherited his paternal uncle Gunan's meng'an, served as overall commander of Basu and as Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit, and died.
claims.sourceText: 入為太子少詹事，再遷開遠軍節度使，襲伯父骨赧猛安，曆婆速路兵馬都總管，西北路招討使，卒。

claims.action: Alubu was Yehe's son.
claims.sourceText: 阿魯補，冶訶之子。

claims.action: He was a man of imposing stature and keen stratagem, fearless in battle.
claims.sourceText: 為人魁偉多智略，勇於戰。

claims.action: Before he came of age he took the field and helped reduce Xianzhou and Dongjing.
claims.sourceText: 未冠從軍，下咸州、東京。

claims.action: When the Liao marched to recover Haizhou he went with the tribal chief Maji to its relief, met a heavy enemy force on the road, fought hard, and took more than a thousand heads.
claims.sourceText: 遼人來取海州，從勃堇麻吉往援，道遇重敵，力戰，斬首千級。

claims.action: He followed Wolugu against Hao and Yizhou, routed seven hundred men with barely a dozen riders, and pressed the attack on the Liao emperor himself.
claims.sourceText: 從斡魯古攻豪、懿州，以十餘騎破敵七百，進襲遼主。

claims.action: Alubu ranged the northern lands and won over twenty-four encampments and several thousand households.
claims.sourceText: 阿魯補徇北地，招降營帳二十四，民戶數千。

claims.action: The Western Capital had fallen. Zhamu failed to take Yingzhou and withdrew to camp north of the city. That night he sent Alubu with four hundred men to scout. The garrison sallied with three thousand in a surprise attack; Alubu met them on the road, took more than a hundred heads, and captured sixty horses.
claims.sourceText: 時已下西京，闍母攻應州未下，退營於州北十餘裏，夜遣阿魯補率兵四百伺敵，城中果出兵三千平襲，阿魯補道與之遇，斬首百余，獲馬六十。

claims.action: When thirty thousand Liao troops marched from Mayi, he met them with a thousand men, broke their line, and killed their general on the field.
claims.sourceText: 後遼兵三萬出馬邑之境，以千兵擊之，斬其將於陣。

claims.action: Early in Tianhui, Zongwang, Prince of Song, marched against Zhang Jue at Pingzhou. Learning that more than ten thousand men from Yingzhou were marching to his aid, he sent Alubu and Alidai to intercept them; they took several thousand heads and returned.
claims.sourceText: 天會初，宋王宗望討張覺于平州，聞應州有兵萬餘來援，遣阿魯補與阿裏帶迎擊之，斬馘數千而還。

claims.action: He again followed his elder brother Yuhua with three thousand men against Qianzhou. Yuhua died on the march and Alubu took over his command. At Qianzhou he received the surrender of the garrison and thirty encampments, seized forty seals, and with Puhui reduced Yizhou.
claims.sourceText: 複從其兄虞劃，率兵三千攻乾州，虞劃道病卒，代領其眾，至乾州，降其軍及營帳三十，獲印四十，與僕虺攻下義州。

claims.action: When Zongwang marched on Song he fought Guo Yaoshi at the White River.
claims.sourceText: 宗望伐宋，與郭藥師戰于白河。

claims.action: Zongwang ordered Alubu to lead two commanderies in the first assault. He fought with exceptional valor and was rewarded beyond the common measure.
claims.sourceText: 宗望命阿魯補以二謀克先登，奮戰，賞賚特異。

claims.action: At Bian he routed the Huainan relief force and killed two of its generals.
claims.sourceText: 至汴，破淮南援兵，斬其二將。

claims.action: The main army withdrew to Mengyang.
claims.sourceText: 大軍退次孟陽。

claims.action: Yao Pingzhong struck by night with a heavy force. Alubu stood directly in their path, fought hard, and drove them off.
claims.sourceText: 姚平仲夜以重兵來襲，阿魯補適當其中，力戰敗之。

claims.action: On the return march he learned that Daming and Kaide had united more than a hundred thousand men to contest the river crossing.
claims.sourceText: 既還，聞大名、開德合兵十余萬來爭河。

claims.action: At the river he saw the enemy was still distant and sent light troops by night. By dawn he reached Weixian, met the foe, took several thousand heads, and put the rest to flight.
claims.sourceText: 至河上，知去敵尚遠，乃以輕兵夜發，詰旦至衛縣，遇敵，斬首數千級，餘皆潰去。

claims.action: The army halted at Xingzhou, where the Hutuo bridge had been burned. Alubu threw a detachment across the water first; by the time the main body arrived the bridge was finished.
claims.sourceText: 師次邢州，滹沱橋已焚，阿魯補先以偏師營于水上，比軍至而橋成。

claims.action: Zongwang praised his service, rewarded him from the Zhending treasury, and made him a thousand-household commander in the Ever-Victorious Army.
claims.sourceText: 宗望嘉其功，出真定庫物賞之，為長勝軍千戶。

claims.action: On the second campaign against Song he followed Zongwang, broke the enemy at Jingxing, and took Luancheng.
claims.sourceText: 及再伐宋，從宗望破敵于井陘，遂下欒城。

claims.action: The army crossed from Daming; Alubu held the approaches to Mingzhou.
claims.sourceText: 師自大名濟河，阿魯補屯於洺州之境。

claims.action: Prince Kang was then at Xiangzhou. Daming sent troops against the Jin camp; Alubu took two hundred horsemen by night, slipped behind them, and routed them.
claims.sourceText: 時康王留相州，大名府以兵來攻我營，阿魯補乘夜以騎二百潛出其後，反擊敗之。

claims.action: A few days later the enemy returned. Commander Su arrived first with twenty thousand men. Alubu struck before they could mass, rode out with three hundred horsemen, shattered their force, took Su alive, and executed him.
claims.sourceText: 居數日，敵複來，蘇統制以兵二萬先至，阿魯補乘其未集，以三百騎出戰，大敗其眾，生擒蘇統制，殺之。

claims.action: After Bianjing fell the army attacked Mingzhou, routed Daming's relief force, and took the city.
claims.sourceText: 大軍既克汴京，攻洺州，敗大名救兵，遂下洺州。

claims.action: Returning from Talanwen's campaign against Enzhou, Mingzhou rose again. Alubu reached the walls first, defeated a sally, seized the defending officials, and with Puluhuan took Xinde.
claims.sourceText: 從撻懶文攻恩州還，洺人複叛，阿魯補先至城下，城中出兵來戰，敗之，執其守佐，，遂與蒲魯懽取信德軍。

claims.action: Zongbi, Prince of Liang, took Kaide, and Alubu marched to his support with five thousand foot.
claims.sourceText: 梁王宗弼取開德，阿魯補以步兵五千赴之。

claims.action: Banditry was rife in Daming, and he was ordered to remain and garrison the region.
claims.sourceText: 大名境內多盜，命阿魯補留屯其地。

claims.action: Bandits struck Shenxian but scattered at word of Alubu's approach. He pursued a day and a night, overtook them at Guantao, and took them all prisoner.
claims.sourceText: 賊犯莘縣，聞阿魯補至，即潰去，追襲一晝夜，至館陶及之，皆俘以歸。

claims.action: He followed Zongbi in the pursuit of Prince Kang and crossed the Huai. Alubu remained at Hezhou with four thousand men, commanding the garrisons between the Yangzi and Huai to bring in counties still holding out.
claims.sourceText: 從宗弼襲康王，即渡淮，阿魯補以兵四千留和州，總督江、淮間戍將，以討未附郡縣。

claims.action: He took Taipingzhou and razed its walls.
claims.sourceText: 遂攻下太平州，隳其城。

claims.action: When Luzhou rebelled he led a detachment against it, routed six thousand horsemen, and took three commanders prisoner.
claims.sourceText: 廬州叛，以偏師討之，敗其騎六千，擒三校。

claims.action: The next day he broke twenty thousand of the enemy at Shenxian and took five hundred heads.
claims.sourceText: 明日複破敵二萬於慎縣，斬首五百。

claims.action: Zhang Yong brought tens of thousands of foot and horse against him. Alubu had only two thousand and was surrounded. He burst the ring, fought through, routed the enemy, pursued forty li, and returned with three hundred captured horses.
claims.sourceText: 張永合步騎數萬來戰，阿魯補兵止二千，敵圍之，阿魯補潰圍力戰，竟敗之，追殺四十裏，獲馬三百而還。

claims.action: He attacked Luzhou again. With Digubu he broke ten thousand men at Tuogao. At the city walls five hundred horsemen sallied; he defeated them and killed two commanders.
claims.sourceText: 再攻廬州，與迪古不敗敵萬眾於拓皋，至廬州，騎兵五百出戰，敗之，斬其二校。

claims.action: The army marched home.
claims.sourceText: 師還。

claims.action: Zongbi hurried west toward Shaanxi. On the road he learned Daming had rebelled again and sent Alubu to deal with it. Alubu went to the walls alone with an interpreter, called on the city to yield, and Daming submitted.
claims.sourceText: 宗弼趨陝西，道聞大名複叛，遣阿魯補經略之，獨與譯者至城下，招之，大名果降。

claims.action: The next day he ordered all private weapons surrendered to the authorities, and officials and people alike returned to their former quiet.
claims.sourceText: 翌日，下令民間兵器，悉上送官，於是吏民按堵如故。

claims.action: He was made commander-in-chief of the Daming-Kaide circuit.
claims.sourceText: 為大名開德路都統。

claims.action: When the Qi puppet state was set up, Alubu encamped his troops outside Bian.
claims.sourceText: 齊國建，阿魯補屯兵於汴城外。

claims.action: In Tianhui 15 an edict abolished Qi. Liu Lin was already in custody, and Alubu entered Bianjing first to guard against trouble.
claims.sourceText: 天會十五年，詔廢齊國，已執劉麟，阿魯補先入汴京備變。

claims.action: The following year he was appointed prefect of Guide.
claims.sourceText: 明年，除歸德尹。

claims.action: When the lands south of the river were ceded to Song, he entered service as Inner Secretariat envoy at Yanjing.
claims.sourceText: 割河南地與宋，入為燕京內省使。

claims.action: When Zongbi recovered the south, Alubu crossed the river first, pacified the prefectures, and again became prefect of Guide and commander-in-chief of Henan.
claims.sourceText: 宗弼複河南，阿魯補先濟河，撫定諸郡，再為歸德尹、河南路都統。

claims.action: Song troops came to recover the south. Zongbi summoned Alubu, Han Chang of Xuzhou, Dachou of Yingzhou, and Chisan Hui of Chenzhou to assemble at Bian. Alubu alone stayed away, for the enemy was at his gates.
claims.sourceText: 宋兵來取河南地，宗弼召阿魯補，與許州韓常、潁州大臭、陳州赤盞暉、皆會于汴，阿魯補以敵在近，獨不赴。

claims.action: Song generals Yue Fei, Liu Guangshi, and others did seize the moment, took Xu, Ying, and Chen, and neighboring districts rose in support.
claims.sourceText: 而宋將岳飛、劉光世等，果乘間襲取許潁三州，旁郡皆回應。

claims.action: The columns that threatened Guide he beat back again and again, retook Bo, Su, and other prefectures, and pacified the south—no man's service surpassed his.
claims.sourceText: 其兵犯歸德者，阿魯補連擊敗之，複取亳、宿等州，河南平，阿魯補功最。

claims.action: In Huangtong 5 he became Associate Administrator of the Branch Secretariat, received a hereditary meng'an, and held a combined commandery command.
claims.sourceText: 皇統五年，為行台參知政事，授世襲猛安，兼合紮謀克。

claims.action: He became Right Army Supervisor of the Marshal's Office, commander of the Basu circuit, and military governor of Guide, rising by stages to Bearer of the Triple Staff with Equal Protocol.
claims.sourceText: 改元帥右監軍，婆速路統軍，歸德軍節度使，累階儀同三司。

claims.action: While at Bian he had taken timber from government buildings and built a private house at Enzhou. The affair now came to light. By law the case called for "deliberation on merit" and "deliberation on kinship".
claims.sourceText: 其在汴時，嘗取官舍材木，構私第於恩州，至是事覺，法當「議勳」「議親」。

claims.action: Hailing, who had once served in the ranks and disliked Alubu, decreed: "Measured by merit and service, others have done more than this.
claims.sourceText: 海陵嘗在軍中，惡阿魯補，詔曰：「若論勳勞，更有過於此者。

claims.action: His rank already stands at the first grade, reward enough in itself.
claims.sourceText: 況官至一品，足以酬之。

claims.action: The state's law makes no distinction between high and low. Kinship and rank cannot set it aside."
claims.sourceText: 國家立法，貴賤一也，豈以親貴而有異也。」

claims.action: He was condemned to death.
claims.sourceText: 遂論死。

claims.action: He was fifty-five.
claims.sourceText: 年五十五。

claims.action: Born to a warrior house, Alubu followed campaign after campaign and won repeated distinction. In every post he ruled with kindness and won the people's hearts.
claims.sourceText: 阿魯補以將家子從征伐，屢立功，曆官有惠愛，得民心。

claims.action: At his death all mourned him.
claims.sourceText: 及死，人皆惜之。

claims.action: In Dading 3 he was posthumously made Bearer of the Triple Staff with Equal Protocol. His son was appointed Right Guard General, inherited the meng'an and personal commandery, and received five hundred taels of silver, twenty bolts of heavy brocade, and three hundred bolts of silk.
claims.sourceText: 大定三年，贈儀同三司，詔以其子為右衛將軍，襲猛安及親管謀克，賜銀五百兩、重彩二十端、絹三百匹。

claims.sourceText: 冶訶子阿魯補、骨赧、訛古乃、散荅。

units.zh: 古者太史掌敘邦國之世次，辨其姓氏，別其昭穆，尚失。
units.en: Even in ancient times the Grand Historian who ordered the ages of the realms, sorted clan names, and marked senior from junior lines could not keep the record whole.
units.literal: In antiquity the Grand Historian kept the generations of the states, distinguished their surnames, and separated zhao from mu—and still there were lapses.

units.zh: 金人初起完毅十二部，其後皆以部為氏，史臣記錄有稱「宗室」者，有稱完顏者。
units.en: The Jin first gathered in the twelve Wanyi tribes, then took each tribe as a clan name. Court historians sometimes wrote "Imperial Clan", sometimes Wanyan.
units.literal: When the Jin people first arose in the twelve tribes of Wanyi, afterward all took their tribe as surname; in the historians' records some are called "Imperial Clan", some Wanyan.

units.zh: 稱完顏者亦有二焉，有同姓完顏，蓋疏族，若石土門、迪古乃是也；
units.en: "Wanyan" itself split two ways: same-surname Wanyan were really distant kin, men like Shitumen and Digunai;
units.literal: Those called Wanyan also fall into two kinds: same-surname Wanyan, who were in fact collateral kin—Shitumen and Digunai are examples;

units.zh: 有異姓完顏，蓋部人，若歡都是也。
units.en: different-surname Wanyan were really tribesmen, men like Huandu.
units.literal: and different-surname Wanyan, who were in fact men of the tribe—Huandu is an example.

units.zh: 大定以前稱「宗室」，明昌以後避睿宗諱稱「內族」，其實一而已，書名不書氏，其制如此。
units.en: Before Dading they were called "Imperial Clan"; after Mingchang, to avoid the taboo on Ruizong, "Inner Kin"—the same group in fact. Registers record personal names, not clan names; that was the rule.
units.literal: Before the Dading era they were called "Imperial Clan"; after Mingchang, to avoid the taboo on Ruizong they were called "Inner Kin"—in substance one and the same. The annals give personal names, not clan names; such was the rule.

units.zh: 宣宗詔宗室皆稱完顏，不復識別焉。
units.en: Emperor Xuanzong ordered that all imperial kin take the name Wanyan, and the old distinctions ceased.
units.literal: Emperor Xuanzong decreed that all of the imperial clan should be called Wanyan, and no further distinction was made.

units.zh: 大定、泰和之間，袒免以上親皆有屬籍，以敘授官，大功以上，薨卒輟朝，親親之道行焉。
units.en: From Dading through Taihe, relatives within tan-mian degree and nearer were entered in the clan rolls and ranked for appointment; when one within da-gong degree or nearer died, court paused in mourning—kinship was honored in deed.
units.literal: Between Dading and Taihe, kin within the degree of tan-mian mourning and closer all had household registers, by which offices were assigned; for kin within the degree of da-gong mourning and closer, death halted court audiences—the way of cherishing kin was practiced.

units.zh: 貞祐以後，譜牒散失，大概僅存，不可殫悉，今掇其可次第者著於篇。
units.en: After Zhenyou the pedigree books were lost; a broken outline alone remains, too fragmentary to exhaust. Here I collect what can still be sequenced and place it in these pages.
units.literal: After Zhenyou the genealogical registers were scattered and lost; only a rough outline survives, and it cannot be set forth in full. Now I gather what can be ordered by generation and set it down in this chapter.

units.zh: 其上無所系、下無所承者，不能盡錄也。
units.en: Lines that attach to nothing above and hand down to nothing below cannot be entered in full.
units.literal: Those with no tie above and no succession below cannot all be recorded.

units.literal: His son Xige inherited the meng'an and was made General of Manifest Martiality.

units.en: When Taizu campaigned against Liao, Gunan fought at Ningjiangzhou and Chuhedian, broke the Liao emperor's personal guard, and was rewarded each time for valor in battle. He inherited his father's commandery.
units.literal: Following Taizu in the campaign against Liao, Gunan fought with the army at Ningjiangzhou and Chuhedian, defeated the Liao emperor's personal troops, and in each case was rewarded for fierce fighting; he inherited his father's commandery.

units.zh: 後領軍鎮夏邊，在職十二年。
units.en: He later commanded the Xia frontier garrison for twelve years.
units.literal: Later he led troops to garrison the Xia frontier and held the post for twelve years.

units.en: In Tianhui 8 he received a hereditary meng'an.
units.literal: In Tianhui year 8 he was granted a hereditary meng'an.

units.literal: At the beginning of Tianjuan he became military governor of Tiande Army and retired from office.

units.en: He rose by stages to Grand Master of the Palace with Equal Protocol and died at eighty-five.
units.literal: By successive promotions he reached Grand Master of the Palace with Equal Protocol and died at age eighty-five.

units.en: Gunan, Yehe's son, was skilled in horsemanship and archery and gifted with ability.
units.literal: Gunan was Yehe's son, skilled in horsemanship and archery, and possessed of ability.

units.en: He took part in suppressing the rebellions of Huanhan, Sanda, Wuchun, Womouhan, and Liuke and distinguished himself in each.
units.literal: He followed in suppressing the rebellions of Huanhan, Sanda, Wuchun, Womouhan, and Liuke, and in each achieved merit.

units.literal: He led the thousand households of Prince of Qin Zonghan and captured the Central and Western capitals.

units.en: When Zonghan marched on Song he besieged Taiyuan without success and returned to the Western Capital. Gunan held Taiyuan with the right wing under Yinshu Ke.
units.literal: Zonghan campaigned against Song and besieged Taiyuan without taking it; Zonghan returned to the Western Capital; Gunan with the right wing assisted Yinshu Ke in defending Taiyuan.

units.zh: 是時汾州、團柏、榆次、嵐、憲、潞皆有兵來援，骨赧凡四戰，皆破之。
units.en: Relief columns came from Fenzhou, Tuanbai, Yuci, Lan, Xian, and Lu. Gunan fought four engagements and won them all.
units.literal: At that time Fenzhou, Tuanbai, Yuci, Lan, Xian, and Lu all sent troops to relieve the city; Gunan fought four battles and defeated them all.

units.zh: 大軍團汴，骨赧引萬戶軍，屢敗其援兵。
units.en: While the main army besieged Bian, Gunan led the ten-thousand-household force and repeatedly routed Song relief columns.
units.literal: The great army besieged Bian; Gunan led the ten-thousand-household army and repeatedly defeated their relief troops.

units.zh: 憲、潞等州複叛，骨赧引兵複取之，並收撫保德、火山而還。
units.en: When Xian, Lu, and other prefectures rebelled again, he retook them, pacified Baode and Huoshan, and returned.
units.literal: Xian, Lu, and other prefectures rebelled again; Gunan led troops to retake them, and also received and pacified Baode and Huoshan before returning.

units.zh: 冶訶子阿魯補、骨赧、訛古乃、散荅。
units.en: Yehe's sons were Alubu, Gunan, Egunai, and Sanda.
units.literal: Yehe's sons were Alubu, Gunan, Egunai, and Sanda.

units.zh: 入為太子少詹事，再遷開遠軍節度使，襲伯父骨赧猛安，曆婆速路兵馬都總管，西北路招討使，卒。
units.en: He entered court as Junior Household Master of the Heir Apparent, became Military Governor of Kaiyuan Army, inherited his paternal uncle Gunan's meng'an, served as overall commander of Basu and as Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit, and died.
units.literal: He entered the capital as Junior Household Master of the Heir Apparent, was again transferred to Military Governor of Kaiyuan Army, inherited his paternal uncle Gunan's meng'an, served successively as overall commander of Basu circuit forces and Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit, and died.

units.zh: 遼主走陰山，耿守忠救西京，帝與宗翰等擊走之。
units.en: The Liao ruler fled to Yinshan; Geng Shouzhong came to relieve the Western Capital; the emperor with Zonghan and others struck and drove him off.
units.literal: The Liao ruler fled to Yinshan; Geng Shouzhong came to relieve the Western Capital; the emperor with Zonghan and others struck and drove him off.

units.zh: 而宗翰來會於濮，既平河北，遂取東平及徐州，盡得宋人江淮運致金幣在徐州官庫者，分給諸軍，而劉豫遂以濟南降。
units.en: Zonghan met him at Pu; Hebei secured, they took Dongping and Xuzhou, emptied the Song treasury of Huai–Yang gold stored at Xuzhou, shared the spoils among the hosts, and Liu Yu surrendered Jinan.
units.literal: Zonghan then joined him at Pu; once Hebei was pacified they took Dongping and Xuzhou, seized all the Song gold and coin the Huai–Yang transport had stored in Xuzhou's government vaults, divided it among the armies, and Liu Yu thereupon surrendered Jinan.

units.zh: 宋主乃貶去帝號，再以書來請存社稷，語在《宗翰傳》中，既而宗弼追宋主，宋渡江，入於杭州，複遁入海，宗弼乃還。
units.en: The Song ruler stripped his imperial title and wrote again to beg the realm be spared—the story is in Zonghan's biography; then Zongbi chased him, Song crossed the Yangtze into Hangzhou, fled to sea, and Zongbi withdrew.
units.literal: The Song ruler then cast off his imperial title and wrote again begging that the state be preserved—the account is in the biography of Zonghan; afterward Zongbi pursued the Song ruler, Song crossed the river, entered Hangzhou, then fled again to sea, and Zongbi returned.

units.zh: 於是，婁室所下陝西城邑輒叛，宗翰等曰：「前討宋，故分西師合於東軍，而陝西五路兵力雄勁，當並力攻取。
units.en: Then the Shaanxi cities Lou Shi had taken rose again, and Zonghan said, "When we first struck Song we merged the western host with the eastern army, but the five Shaanxi circuits are strong—we should strike with united force.
units.literal: Thereupon the Shaanxi towns Lou Shi had taken kept rebelling, and Zonghan and the others said: "In the earlier campaign against Song we joined the western army to the eastern host, yet the five Shaanxi circuits field fierce strength—we ought to attack together.

units.zh: 於是班師，與宗翰俱朝京師，立熙宗為諳版勃極烈，帝為左副元帥。
units.en: They withdrew to court; with Zonghan they installed Hela as an-ban boji lie and made the emperor left deputy commander-in-chief.
units.literal: The army then withdrew; together with Zonghan he came to court, Hela was installed as an-ban boji lie, and the emperor became left deputy commander-in-chief.

units.zh: 今撻懶撫定江北，宗弼以精兵二萬先往洛陽。
units.en: Tadan has pacified the country north of the river; let Zongbi march twenty thousand picked men to Luoyang first.
units.literal: Now Tadan has settled the north of the river; let Zongbi take twenty thousand elite troops first to Luoyang.

units.zh: 以八月往陝西，或使宗弼遂將以行，或宗輔、宗幹、希尹中以一人往。」
units.en: In the eighth month march on Shaanxi—either Zongbi leads the whole way, or one of Zongfu, Zonggan, and Xiyin goes."
units.literal: In the eighth month go to Shaanxi—either have Zongbi lead the army through, or send one among Zongfu, Zonggan, and Xiyin."

units.zh: 複從其兄虞劃，率兵三千攻乾州，虞劃道病卒，代領其眾，至乾州，降其軍及營帳三十，獲印四十，與僕虺攻下義州。
units.en: He again followed his elder brother Yuhua with three thousand men against Qianzhou. Yuhua died on the march and Alubu took over his command. At Qianzhou he received the surrender of the garrison and thirty encampments, seized forty seals, and with Puhui reduced Yizhou.
units.literal: He again followed his elder brother Yuhua, leading three thousand men to attack Qianzhou; Yuhua died of illness on the road; Alubu took command of his force; reaching Qianzhou he received the surrender of their army and thirty encampments, seized forty seals, and with Puhui captured Yizhou.

units.zh: 大定三年，贈儀同三司，詔以其子為右衛將軍，襲猛安及親管謀克，賜銀五百兩、重彩二十端、絹三百匹。
units.en: In Dading 3 he was posthumously made Bearer of the Triple Staff with Equal Protocol. His son was appointed Right Guard General, inherited the meng'an and personal commandery, and received five hundred taels of silver, twenty bolts of heavy brocade, and three hundred bolts of silk.
units.literal: In Dading year 3 he was posthumously made Bearer of the Triple Staff with Equal Protocol; an edict made his son Right Guard General, inheriting the meng'an and personally administered commandery, and granted five hundred taels of silver, twenty bolts of heavy brocade, and three hundred bolts of silk.

units.zh: 宗望嘉其功，出真定庫物賞之，為長勝軍千戶。
units.en: Zongwang praised his service, rewarded him from the Zhending treasury, and made him a thousand-household commander in the Ever-Victorious Army.
units.literal: Zongwang praised his merit, drew goods from the Zhending treasury to reward him, and made him commander of a thousand households in the Ever-Victorious Army.

units.en: He was made commander-in-chief of the Daming-Kaide circuit.
units.literal: He became commander-in-chief of the Daming-Kaide circuit.

units.en: The following year he was appointed prefect of Guide.
units.literal: The following year he was made prefect of Guide.

units.zh: 割河南地與宋，入為燕京內省使。
units.en: When the lands south of the river were ceded to Song, he entered service as Inner Secretariat envoy at Yanjing.
units.literal: When the lands south of the river were ceded to Song, he entered the capital as Inner Secretariat envoy of Yanjing.

units.zh: 宗弼複河南，阿魯補先濟河，撫定諸郡，再為歸德尹、河南路都統。
units.en: When Zongbi recovered the south, Alubu crossed the river first, pacified the prefectures, and again became prefect of Guide and commander-in-chief of Henan.
units.literal: When Zongbi recovered the lands south of the river, Alubu crossed the river first, pacified and settled the prefectures, and again became prefect of Guide and commander-in-chief of the Henan circuit.

units.zh: 皇統五年，為行台參知政事，授世襲猛安，兼合紮謀克。
units.en: In Huangtong 5 he became Associate Administrator of the Branch Secretariat, received a hereditary meng'an, and held a combined commandery command.
units.literal: In Huangtong year 5 he became Associate Administrator of the Branch Secretariat, was granted a hereditary meng'an, and concurrently held a combined commandery post.

units.zh: 改元帥右監軍，婆速路統軍，歸德軍節度使，累階儀同三司。
units.en: He became Right Army Supervisor of the Marshal's Office, commander of the Basu circuit, and military governor of Guide, rising by stages to Bearer of the Triple Staff with Equal Protocol.
units.literal: He was changed to Right Army Supervisor of the Marshal's Office, commander of the Basu circuit, military governor of Guide Army, and rose by stages to Bearer of the Triple Staff with Equal Protocol.

units.zh: 為人魁偉多智略，勇於戰。
units.en: He was a man of imposing stature and keen stratagem, fearless in battle.
units.literal: As a man he was tall and imposing, full of stratagems, and bold in battle.

units.zh: 阿魯補以將家子從征伐，屢立功，曆官有惠愛，得民心。
units.en: Born to a warrior house, Alubu followed campaign after campaign and won repeated distinction. In every post he ruled with kindness and won the people's hearts.
units.literal: Alubu, as the son of a military family, followed the campaigns and repeatedly achieved merit; in his successive offices he showed kindness and won the hearts of the people.

units.en: At his death all mourned him.
units.literal: When he died, all regretted it.
He was therefore sentenced to death.

units.en: Before he came of age he took the field and helped reduce Xianzhou and Dongjing.
units.literal: Before coming of age he followed the army and captured Xianzhou and Dongjing.

units.zh: 遼人來取海州，從勃堇麻吉往援，道遇重敵，力戰，斬首千級。
units.en: When the Liao marched to recover Haizhou he went with the tribal chief Maji to its relief, met a heavy enemy force on the road, fought hard, and took more than a thousand heads.
units.literal: When the Liao came to retake Haizhou, he followed the tribal chief Maji to relieve it; on the road they met a strong enemy and fought fiercely, beheading more than a thousand.

units.zh: 從斡魯古攻豪、懿州，以十餘騎破敵七百，進襲遼主。
units.en: He followed Wolugu against Hao and Yizhou, routed seven hundred men with barely a dozen riders, and pressed the attack on the Liao emperor himself.
units.literal: He followed Wolugu in attacking Hao and Yizhou, with a dozen horsemen broke seven hundred of the enemy, and pressed on to strike the Liao emperor.

units.zh: 阿魯補徇北地，招降營帳二十四，民戶數千。
units.en: Alubu ranged the northern lands and won over twenty-four encampments and several thousand households.
units.literal: Alubu swept the northern country, receiving the submission of twenty-four encampments and several thousand households.

units.zh: 時已下西京，闍母攻應州未下，退營於州北十餘裏，夜遣阿魯補率兵四百伺敵，城中果出兵三千平襲，阿魯補道與之遇，斬首百余，獲馬六十。
units.en: The Western Capital had fallen. Zhamu failed to take Yingzhou and withdrew to camp north of the city. That night he sent Alubu with four hundred men to scout. The garrison sallied with three thousand in a surprise attack; Alubu met them on the road, took more than a hundred heads, and captured sixty horses.
units.literal: The Western Capital had already been taken; Zhamu attacked Yingzhou without success, withdrew and encamped more than ten li north of the city, and by night sent Alubu with four hundred men to watch the enemy; the city indeed sent out three thousand in a surprise attack; Alubu met them on the road, beheaded more than a hundred, and seized sixty horses.

units.zh: 後遼兵三萬出馬邑之境，以千兵擊之，斬其將於陣。
units.en: When thirty thousand Liao troops marched from Mayi, he met them with a thousand men, broke their line, and killed their general on the field.
units.literal: Later thirty thousand Liao troops came out from the borders of Mayi; with a thousand men he attacked them and beheaded their general in the battle line.

units.zh: 天會初，宋王宗望討張覺于平州，聞應州有兵萬餘來援，遣阿魯補與阿裏帶迎擊之，斬馘數千而還。
units.en: Early in Tianhui, Zongwang, Prince of Song, marched against Zhang Jue at Pingzhou. Learning that more than ten thousand men from Yingzhou were marching to his aid, he sent Alubu and Alidai to intercept them; they took several thousand heads and returned.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianhui, Prince of Song Zongwang campaigned against Zhang Jue at Pingzhou; hearing that more than ten thousand troops from Yingzhou were coming to relieve him, he sent Alubu and Alidai to meet and attack them, beheading several thousand before returning.

units.zh: 宗望伐宋，與郭藥師戰于白河。
units.en: When Zongwang marched on Song he fought Guo Yaoshi at the White River.
units.literal: Zongwang campaigned against Song and fought Guo Yaoshi at the White River.

units.zh: 宗望命阿魯補以二謀克先登，奮戰，賞賚特異。
units.en: Zongwang ordered Alubu to lead two commanderies in the first assault. He fought with exceptional valor and was rewarded beyond the common measure.
units.literal: Zongwang ordered Alubu to lead two commanderies in the first assault; he fought fiercely and received exceptional rewards.

units.zh: 至汴，破淮南援兵，斬其二將。
units.en: At Bian he routed the Huainan relief force and killed two of its generals.
units.literal: Reaching Bian, he defeated the Huainan relief troops and beheaded two of their generals.

units.en: The main army withdrew to Mengyang.
units.literal: The great army withdrew and encamped at Mengyang.

units.zh: 姚平仲夜以重兵來襲，阿魯補適當其中，力戰敗之。
units.en: Yao Pingzhong struck by night with a heavy force. Alubu stood directly in their path, fought hard, and drove them off.
units.literal: Yao Pingzhong came by night with a heavy force to attack; Alubu happened to be in their path and fought fiercely to defeat them.

units.zh: 既還，聞大名、開德合兵十余萬來爭河。
units.en: On the return march he learned that Daming and Kaide had united more than a hundred thousand men to contest the river crossing.
units.literal: After returning, he heard that Daming and Kaide had combined more than a hundred thousand troops to contest the river.

units.zh: 至河上，知去敵尚遠，乃以輕兵夜發，詰旦至衛縣，遇敵，斬首數千級，餘皆潰去。
units.en: At the river he saw the enemy was still distant and sent light troops by night. By dawn he reached Weixian, met the foe, took several thousand heads, and put the rest to flight.
units.literal: Reaching the river and knowing the enemy was still far off, he sent light troops by night; at dawn he reached Weixian, met the enemy, beheaded several thousand, and the rest all fled.

units.zh: 師次邢州，滹沱橋已焚，阿魯補先以偏師營于水上，比軍至而橋成。
units.en: The army halted at Xingzhou, where the Hutuo bridge had been burned. Alubu threw a detachment across the water first; by the time the main body arrived the bridge was finished.
units.literal: The army halted at Xingzhou; the Hutuo bridge had been burned; Alubu first camped a detached force on the water, and by the time the army arrived the bridge was complete.

units.zh: 及再伐宋，從宗望破敵于井陘，遂下欒城。
units.en: On the second campaign against Song he followed Zongwang, broke the enemy at Jingxing, and took Luancheng.
units.literal: When Song was attacked again, he followed Zongwang in defeating the enemy at Jingxing and then took Luancheng.

units.zh: 師自大名濟河，阿魯補屯於洺州之境。
units.en: The army crossed from Daming; Alubu held the approaches to Mingzhou.
units.literal: The army crossed the river from Daming; Alubu encamped in the territory of Mingzhou.

units.zh: 時康王留相州，大名府以兵來攻我營，阿魯補乘夜以騎二百潛出其後，反擊敗之。
units.en: Prince Kang was then at Xiangzhou. Daming sent troops against the Jin camp; Alubu took two hundred horsemen by night, slipped behind them, and routed them.
units.literal: At that time Prince Kang remained at Xiangzhou; troops from Daming Prefecture came to attack our camp; Alubu by night with two hundred horsemen stole out behind them and counterattacked to defeat them.

units.zh: 居數日，敵複來，蘇統制以兵二萬先至，阿魯補乘其未集，以三百騎出戰，大敗其眾，生擒蘇統制，殺之。
units.en: A few days later the enemy returned. Commander Su arrived first with twenty thousand men. Alubu struck before they could mass, rode out with three hundred horsemen, shattered their force, took Su alive, and executed him.
units.literal: After several days the enemy came again; Commander Su with twenty thousand men arrived first; Alubu, seizing them before they had fully gathered, went out with three hundred horsemen, routed their force, captured Commander Su alive, and killed him.

units.zh: 大軍既克汴京，攻洺州，敗大名救兵，遂下洺州。
units.en: After Bianjing fell the army attacked Mingzhou, routed Daming's relief force, and took the city.
units.literal: After the great army had taken Bianjing, they attacked Mingzhou, defeated Daming's relief troops, and then took Mingzhou.

units.zh: 從撻懶文攻恩州還，洺人複叛，阿魯補先至城下，城中出兵來戰，敗之，執其守佐，，遂與蒲魯懽取信德軍。
units.en: Returning from Talanwen's campaign against Enzhou, Mingzhou rose again. Alubu reached the walls first, defeated a sally, seized the defending officials, and with Puluhuan took Xinde.
units.literal: Returning from following Talanwen's attack on Enzhou, the people of Mingzhou rebelled again; Alubu reached the city first; the city sent troops out to fight and he defeated them, seized their defending officials, and then with Puluhuan took Xinde Army.

units.zh: 梁王宗弼取開德，阿魯補以步兵五千赴之。
units.en: Zongbi, Prince of Liang, took Kaide, and Alubu marched to his support with five thousand foot.
units.literal: Prince of Liang Zongbi took Kaide; Alubu went to his aid with five thousand foot soldiers.

units.zh: 大名境內多盜，命阿魯補留屯其地。
units.en: Banditry was rife in Daming, and he was ordered to remain and garrison the region.
units.literal: Bandits were numerous within Daming territory; he was ordered to remain and garrison the region.

units.zh: 賊犯莘縣，聞阿魯補至，即潰去，追襲一晝夜，至館陶及之，皆俘以歸。
units.en: Bandits struck Shenxian but scattered at word of Alubu's approach. He pursued a day and a night, overtook them at Guantao, and took them all prisoner.
units.literal: Bandits raided Shenxian; hearing Alubu had come they at once fled; he pursued for a day and a night, overtook them at Guantao, and took them all prisoner.

units.zh: 從宗弼襲康王，即渡淮，阿魯補以兵四千留和州，總督江、淮間戍將，以討未附郡縣。
units.en: He followed Zongbi in the pursuit of Prince Kang and crossed the Huai. Alubu remained at Hezhou with four thousand men, commanding the garrisons between the Yangzi and Huai to bring in counties still holding out.
units.literal: Following Zongbi in the pursuit of Prince Kang, they crossed the Huai at once; Alubu remained at Hezhou with four thousand men, overseeing the garrison commanders between the Yangzi and Huai to subdue counties not yet submitted.

units.en: He took Taipingzhou and razed its walls.
units.literal: He then attacked and took Taipingzhou and demolished its walls.

units.zh: 廬州叛，以偏師討之，敗其騎六千，擒三校。
units.en: When Luzhou rebelled he led a detachment against it, routed six thousand horsemen, and took three commanders prisoner.
units.literal: Luzhou rebelled; with a detached force he campaigned against it, defeated six thousand of their horsemen, and captured three commanders.

units.zh: 明日複破敵二萬於慎縣，斬首五百。
units.en: The next day he broke twenty thousand of the enemy at Shenxian and took five hundred heads.
units.literal: The next day he again defeated twenty thousand of the enemy at Shenxian and beheaded five hundred.

units.zh: 張永合步騎數萬來戰，阿魯補兵止二千，敵圍之，阿魯補潰圍力戰，竟敗之，追殺四十裏，獲馬三百而還。
units.en: Zhang Yong brought tens of thousands of foot and horse against him. Alubu had only two thousand and was surrounded. He burst the ring, fought through, routed the enemy, pursued forty li, and returned with three hundred captured horses.
units.literal: Zhang Yong combined infantry and cavalry numbering tens of thousands to give battle; Alubu had only two thousand men; the enemy surrounded them; Alubu broke out of the encirclement and fought fiercely, finally defeating them, pursued and killed for forty li, seized three hundred horses, and returned.

units.zh: 再攻廬州，與迪古不敗敵萬眾於拓皋，至廬州，騎兵五百出戰，敗之，斬其二校。
units.en: He attacked Luzhou again. With Digubu he broke ten thousand men at Tuogao. At the city walls five hundred horsemen sallied; he defeated them and killed two commanders.
units.literal: Attacking Luzhou again, he and Digubu defeated ten thousand of the enemy at Tuogao; reaching Luzhou, five hundred horsemen came out to fight; he defeated them and beheaded two commanders.

units.zh: 宗弼趨陝西，道聞大名複叛，遣阿魯補經略之，獨與譯者至城下，招之，大名果降。
units.en: Zongbi hurried west toward Shaanxi. On the road he learned Daming had rebelled again and sent Alubu to deal with it. Alubu went to the walls alone with an interpreter, called on the city to yield, and Daming submitted.
units.literal: Zongbi hurried toward Shaanxi; on the road he heard Daming had rebelled again and sent Alubu to manage the matter; Alubu went alone with an interpreter to the foot of the walls and summoned them; Daming indeed submitted.

units.zh: 翌日，下令民間兵器，悉上送官，於是吏民按堵如故。
units.en: The next day he ordered all private weapons surrendered to the authorities, and officials and people alike returned to their former quiet.
units.literal: The next day he ordered that weapons among the people all be handed up to the authorities; officials and commoners then lived in peace as before.

units.zh: 齊國建，阿魯補屯兵於汴城外。
units.en: When the Qi puppet state was set up, Alubu encamped his troops outside Bian.
units.literal: When the Qi state was established, Alubu garrisoned troops outside the walls of Bian.

units.zh: 天會十五年，詔廢齊國，已執劉麟，阿魯補先入汴京備變。
units.en: In Tianhui 15 an edict abolished Qi. Liu Lin was already in custody, and Alubu entered Bianjing first to guard against trouble.
units.literal: In Tianhui year 15 an edict abolished the Qi state; Liu Lin had already been seized; Alubu entered Bianjing first to guard against disturbance.

units.zh: 宋兵來取河南地，宗弼召阿魯補，與許州韓常、潁州大臭、陳州赤盞暉、皆會于汴，阿魯補以敵在近，獨不赴。
units.en: Song troops came to recover the south. Zongbi summoned Alubu, Han Chang of Xuzhou, Dachou of Yingzhou, and Chisan Hui of Chenzhou to assemble at Bian. Alubu alone stayed away, for the enemy was at his gates.
units.literal: Song troops came to recover the lands south of the river; Zongbi summoned Alubu, Han Chang of Xuzhou, Dachou of Yingzhou, and Chisan Hui of Chenzhou to assemble at Bian; Alubu, because the enemy was near, alone did not go.

units.zh: 而宋將岳飛、劉光世等，果乘間襲取許潁三州，旁郡皆回應。
units.en: Song generals Yue Fei, Liu Guangshi, and others did seize the moment, took Xu, Ying, and Chen, and neighboring districts rose in support.
units.literal: Song generals Yue Fei, Liu Guangshi, and others indeed seized the opportunity to strike and take the three prefectures of Xu, Ying, and Chen; neighboring commanderies all responded in turn.

units.zh: 其兵犯歸德者，阿魯補連擊敗之，複取亳、宿等州，河南平，阿魯補功最。
units.en: The columns that threatened Guide he beat back again and again, retook Bo, Su, and other prefectures, and pacified the south—no man's service surpassed his.
units.literal: Those of their troops that invaded Guide, Alubu repeatedly defeated; he recovered Bo, Su, and other prefectures; the south was pacified, and Alubu's merit was greatest.

units.zh: 其在汴時，嘗取官舍材木，構私第於恩州，至是事覺，法當「議勳」「議親」。
units.en: While at Bian he had taken timber from government buildings and built a private house at Enzhou. The affair now came to light. By law the case called for "deliberation on merit" and "deliberation on kinship".
units.literal: While at Bian he had once taken timber from government buildings and built a private residence at Enzhou; by now the matter came to light; by law it called for "deliberation on merit" and "deliberation on kinship".

units.zh: 海陵嘗在軍中，惡阿魯補，詔曰：「若論勳勞，更有過於此者。
units.en: Hailing, who had once served in the ranks and disliked Alubu, decreed: "Measured by merit and service, others have done more than this.
units.literal: Hailing had once been in the army and disliked Alubu; an edict said: "If one considers merit and labor, there are those who have done more than this.

units.en: His rank already stands at the first grade, reward enough in itself.
units.literal: Moreover his office has reached the first rank, which is sufficient recompense.

units.zh: 國家立法，貴賤一也，豈以親貴而有異也。」
units.en: The state's law makes no distinction between high and low. Kinship and rank cannot set it aside."
units.literal: The state establishes law; noble and base are one; how could there be difference because of kinship and eminence?"
